name: Ce qu'il advint de Nana
source: "Nana is 16, she's been missing. They found a corpse by the side of the road. Marie, her sister, doesn't believe it's Nana. Because there's this red journal, with all those teenage secrets written in an unknown language."
translation: “娜娜16岁了，她失踪了。他们在路边发现了一具尸体。她的妹妹玛丽不相信那是娜娜。因为有一本红色日记，里面所有的青少年秘密都用一种未知的语言写着。”
